parameters.formDescription: Describe what you want in plain language, for example: visit the lake and the tree, flashing blue, then park on the dock. The model turns it into a plan and n8n executes the plan step by step.

parameters.text:
=Turn this mission into a plan for a rover.

Mission: {{ $json.Mission }}

The rover can drive to these named places only: lake, tree, house, mountain, dock, center.
Its LED can be: red, green, blue, yellow, magenta, cyan, white, off.

Answer with JSON ONLY, no prose and no code fences, in exactly this shape:
{"summary": "one sentence", "steps": [{"place": "lake", "led": "blue", "why": "short reason"}]}

Use at most 6 steps. Every place must be one of the allowed names.

messageValues.message: You are a mission planner for a small rover. You only ever answer with valid JSON matching the requested shape.

parameters.goalJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ waypoint_names: [$('One Step at a Time').item.json.place], loops: 1, dock_when_done: false }) }}

parameters.completionMessage:
={{ $('Parse the Plan').first().json.summary }}

Steps executed: {{ $('Parse the Plan').all().map(i => i.json.index + '. ' + i.json.place + ' (' + i.json.led + ') — ' + i.json.why).join('\n') }}
